pages.privacy.10.en: Without online play, your village stays on your device and the game sends us nothing about you (unless you turn on crash reports).
pages.privacy.10.text: Bila kucheza mtandaoni, kijiji chako kinabaki kwenye kifaa chako na mchezo haututumii chochote kukuhusu (isipokuwa ukiwasha ripoti za hitilafu).

pages.privacy.11.en: For online play we keep what the game needs: an account with a random Player ID, the name you choose, your village and battles, chat, friends and purchases.
pages.privacy.11.text: Kwa kucheza mtandaoni tunahifadhi kile mchezo unachohitaji: akaunti yenye Kitambulisho cha Mchezaji cha nasibu, jina unalochagua, kijiji chako na vita, gumzo, marafiki na manunuzi.

pages.privacy.12.en: We do not ask for your email address, real name, contacts or location in the game. There are no ads, no tracking across other apps, and we never sell your data.
pages.privacy.12.text: Hatuombi anwani yako ya barua pepe, jina lako halisi, anwani za watu unaowasiliana nao wala mahali ulipo katika mchezo. Hakuna matangazo, hakuna ufuatiliaji kupitia programu nyingine, na kamwe hatuuzi data yako.

pages.privacy.13.en: You can delete your online account in the game or on the web at any time.
pages.privacy.13.text: Unaweza kufuta akaunti yako ya mtandaoni katika mchezo au kwenye wavuti wakati wowote.

pages.privacy.14.text: Makundi ya umri na wachezaji wadogo

pages.privacy.15.en: Kagemura is a strategy game with cartoon combat, rated for teens and up in the app stores. Before you play online, the game asks your year of birth (and the month, only when the year alone does not settle it) without suggesting an answer, or uses the age range your device's app store provides. It keeps only the resulting age group (under 13, 13 to 17, or 18 or older), not your date of birth, and uses it only to set up the game for your age:
pages.privacy.15.text: Kagemura ni mchezo wa mikakati wenye mapigano ya katuni, uliopangiwa vijana na kuendelea katika maduka ya programu. Kabla ya kucheza mtandaoni, mchezo unauliza mwaka wako wa kuzaliwa (na mwezi, pale tu mwaka peke yake hautoshi kuamua) bila kupendekeza jibu, au unatumia kiwango cha umri kinachotolewa na duka la programu la kifaa chako. Unahifadhi tu kundi la umri linalotokana (chini ya 13, 13 hadi 17, au 18 au zaidi), si tarehe yako ya kuzaliwa, na unalitumia tu kuandaa mchezo kwa umri wako:

pages.privacy.16.en: {t0}Under 13:{t1} no free-text chat (only a set of fixed phrases such as "Good luck!"), a generated player name instead of a chosen one, and other players cannot find you by name. You can still play, raid and join an Alliance.
pages.privacy.16.text: {t0}Chini ya 13:{t1} hakuna gumzo la maandishi huru (ni seti ya misemo iliyowekwa tu kama "Kila la heri!"), jina la mchezaji lililotengenezwa badala ya lililochaguliwa, na wachezaji wengine hawawezi kukupata kwa jina. Bado unaweza kucheza, kuvamia na kujiunga na Muungano.

pages.privacy.17.en: {t0}13 to 17:{t1} only friends of your friends can find you by name, and friends do not see when you were last online, until you change these in Settings.
pages.privacy.17.text: {t0}13 hadi 17:{t1} marafiki wa marafiki zako pekee ndio wanaoweza kukupata kwa jina, na marafiki hawaoni ulipokuwa mtandaoni mara ya mwisho, hadi ubadilishe haya kwenye Mipangilio.

pages.privacy.18.en: {t0}Under 18 (both younger groups):{t1} a monthly spending limit, an extra "check with a grown-up" step before buying, and no limited-time offers that pop up on their own.
pages.privacy.18.text: {t0}Chini ya 18 (makundi yote mawili ya wadogo):{t1} kikomo cha matumizi cha kila mwezi, hatua ya ziada ya "uliza mtu mzima" kabla ya kununua, na hakuna ofa za muda mfupi zinazojitokeza zenyewe.

pages.privacy.19.en: The age group is your own statement, not age verification. Once you have said you are under 18, the game cannot switch you back to adult on its own; our support team can, after checking. If you are a parent and believe your child gave a wrong age or shared personal details, write to us and we will help, including deleting the account. These protections apply in versions of the game released with them; older versions ask the age group only before a first purchase.
pages.privacy.19.text: Kundi la umri ni kauli yako mwenyewe, si uthibitishaji wa umri. Ukishasema uko chini ya miaka 18, mchezo hauwezi kukurudisha kuwa mtu mzima wenyewe; timu yetu ya usaidizi inaweza, baada ya kukagua. Ikiwa wewe ni mzazi na unaamini mtoto wako alitoa umri usio sahihi au alishiriki taarifa binafsi, tuandikie nasi tutasaidia, ikiwemo kufuta akaunti. Kinga hizi zinatumika katika matoleo ya mchezo yaliyotolewa nazo; matoleo ya zamani huuliza kundi la umri kabla ya ununuzi wa kwanza tu.

pages.privacy.21.en: Your village is saved on your device. The game does not need an account, and with online play off it sends nothing about you to us (unless you turn on crash reports, below). Gameplay statistics shown in Settings ("Analytics events") stay on the device, unless you are an adult playing online and choose to share them (below). If you play in a web browser, the website that delivers the game sees your IP address, as every website does.
pages.privacy.21.text: Kijiji chako kimehifadhiwa kwenye kifaa chako. Mchezo hauhitaji akaunti, na kucheza mtandaoni kukiwa kumezimwa hautumi chochote kukuhusu kwetu (isipokuwa ukiwasha ripoti za hitilafu, hapa chini). Takwimu za mchezo zinazoonyeshwa kwenye Mipangilio ("Matukio ya takwimu") zinabaki kwenye kifaa, isipokuwa uwe mtu mzima anayecheza mtandaoni na uchague kuzishiriki (hapa chini). Ukicheza kwenye kivinjari, tovuti inayowasilisha mchezo huona anwani yako ya IP, kama kila tovuti inavyofanya.

pages.privacy.22.en: What we collect, why, and on what legal basis
pages.privacy.22.text: Tunachokusanya, kwa nini, na kwa msingi gani wa kisheria

pages.privacy.23.en: The legal bases are those of the EU and UK GDPR (Art. 6) and of Brazil's LGPD (Art. 7). "Contract" means we need the data to provide the game you asked to play; "legitimate interests" means we have weighed our reason against your rights and you can object (see "Your rights").
pages.privacy.23.text: Misingi ya kisheria ni ile ya GDPR ya Umoja wa Ulaya na Uingereza (Ibara ya 6) na ya LGPD ya Brazili (Ibara ya 7). "Mkataba" maana yake tunahitaji data ili kutoa mchezo uliouomba kucheza; "maslahi halali" maana yake tumepima sababu yetu dhidi ya haki zako na unaweza kupinga (tazama "Haki zako").

pages.privacy.24.en: Online account: random Player ID, a secret sign-in token (we store only a one-way hash), the name you choose, your friend code, your age group, your privacy choices, when you were last online
pages.privacy.24.text: Akaunti ya mtandaoni: Kitambulisho cha Mchezaji cha nasibu, tokeni ya siri ya kuingia (tunahifadhi hashi ya njia moja tu), jina unalochagua, msimbo wako wa rafiki, kundi lako la umri, chaguo zako za faragha, ulipokuwa mtandaoni mara ya mwisho

pages.privacy.25.en: To run your online account, show your name to other players and apply the protections for your age group. Basis: contract; for the age group also legal obligation and legitimate interests (protecting younger players). LGPD: contract performance, legal obligation.
pages.privacy.25.text: Ili kuendesha akaunti yako ya mtandaoni, kuonyesha jina lako kwa wachezaji wengine na kutumia kinga za kundi lako la umri. Msingi: mkataba; kwa kundi la umri pia wajibu wa kisheria na maslahi halali (kuwalinda wachezaji wadogo). LGPD: utekelezaji wa mkataba, wajibu wa kisheria.

pages.privacy.26.en: Your game: your base for raids, the village kept on our server and the actions you take in it, battles and replays, honor, rankings and ratings, a history of resources added or spent
pages.privacy.26.text: Mchezo wako: kambi yako ya mavamizi, kijiji kinachohifadhiwa kwenye seva yetu na vitendo unavyofanya ndani yake, vita na marudio, heshima, viwango na ukadiriaji, historia ya rasilimali zilizoongezwa au kutumika

pages.privacy.27.en: So online play works, raids are checked and fair, and you can continue on another device. Basis: contract; checking battles for cheating is a legitimate interest.
pages.privacy.27.text: Ili kucheza mtandaoni kufanye kazi, mavamizi yakaguliwe na yawe ya haki, na uweze kuendelea kwenye kifaa kingine. Msingi: mkataba; kukagua vita dhidi ya udanganyifu ni maslahi halali.

pages.privacy.28.en: Social features: Alliance and Gang chat messages, warrior requests and gifts, friends and friend requests, Gangs, Gang Wars and Friendly Duels
pages.privacy.28.text: Vipengele vya kijamii: jumbe za gumzo za Muungano na Genge, maombi na zawadi za wapiganaji, marafiki na maombi ya urafiki, Magenge, Vita vya Genge na Mapambano ya Kirafiki

pages.privacy.29.en: To provide these features. Basis: contract.
pages.privacy.29.text: Ili kutoa vipengele hivi. Msingi: mkataba.

pages.privacy.30.en: Safety: reports you make (reason, optional note and, for a chat message, its text as it was sent), blocks, mutes and suspensions, and the notices we send you about them (kept in your account until it is deleted)
pages.privacy.30.text: Usalama: ripoti unazotuma (sababu, maelezo ya hiari na, kwa ujumbe wa gumzo, maandishi yake kama yalivyotumwa), vizuizi, unyamazishaji na usimamishaji, na taarifa tunazokutumia kuyahusu (zinahifadhiwa kwenye akaunti yako hadi ifutwe)

pages.privacy.31.en: To keep the community safe, act on reports, tell reporters and affected players what we decided, and handle appeals. Basis: legitimate interests (a safe game for everyone) and, where online-safety laws require it, legal obligation.
pages.privacy.31.text: Ili kuweka jumuiya salama, kushughulikia ripoti, kuwaambia waliotoa ripoti na wachezaji walioathiriwa tulichoamua, na kushughulikia rufaa. Msingi: maslahi halali (mchezo salama kwa kila mtu) na, pale sheria za usalama mtandaoni zinapotaka, wajibu wa kisheria.

pages.privacy.32.en: Sign-ins you link (optional): the id that Apple, Google or Game Center gives us for you; for Sign in with Apple also the token Apple issues to the game; which sign-in each of your devices used and when it was last used
pages.privacy.32.text: Njia za kuingia unazounganisha (hiari): kitambulisho ambacho Apple, Google au Game Center hutupa kwa ajili yako; kwa Sign in with Apple pia tokeni ambayo Apple hutoa kwa mchezo; ni njia gani ya kuingia kila kifaa chako kilitumia na ilitumika lini mara ya mwisho

pages.privacy.33.en: To restore your account on another device, sign out devices when you unlink a sign-in, and revoke the game's access at Apple when you delete your account or unlink Apple. We never receive or keep your email address or name from them. Basis: contract, at your request.
pages.privacy.33.text: Ili kurejesha akaunti yako kwenye kifaa kingine, kutoa vifaa unapotenganisha njia ya kuingia, na kubatilisha ufikiaji wa mchezo kwa Apple unapofuta akaunti yako au kutenganisha Apple. Kamwe hatupokei wala kuhifadhi anwani yako ya barua pepe au jina lako kutoka kwao. Msingi: mkataba, kwa ombi lako.

pages.privacy.34.en: Purchases: the store's transaction id, product, price, date and refund status
pages.privacy.34.text: Manunuzi: kitambulisho cha muamala cha duka, bidhaa, bei, tarehe na hali ya urejeshaji wa pesa

pages.privacy.35.en: To deliver each purchase once, restore it, handle refunds and apply the under-18 limit. Basis: contract and legal obligation (tax and accounting records).
pages.privacy.35.text: Ili kuwasilisha kila ununuzi mara moja, kuurejesha, kushughulikia marejesho ya pesa na kutumia kikomo cha walio chini ya miaka 18. Msingi: mkataba na wajibu wa kisheria (kumbukumbu za kodi na uhasibu).

pages.privacy.36.en: Notifications (optional): your device's notification token, the types you chose and your time-zone offset
pages.privacy.36.text: Arifa (hiari): tokeni ya arifa ya kifaa chako, aina ulizochagua na tofauti ya saa za eneo lako

pages.privacy.37.en: To send only the notifications you switched on, never at night or too often. Basis: consent (you turn them on, and can turn them off).
pages.privacy.37.text: Ili kutuma tu arifa ulizowasha, kamwe si usiku wala mara nyingi mno. Msingi: ridhaa (unaziwasha, na unaweza kuzizima).

pages.privacy.38.en: Network data: your IP address with each request to our server
pages.privacy.38.text: Data ya mtandao: anwani yako ya IP kwa kila ombi kwa seva yetu

pages.privacy.39.en: To stop abuse (rate limits) and keep the service secure. Kept only in short-lived counters and in server logs. We do not use it to work out where you are. Basis: legitimate interests (security).
pages.privacy.39.text: Ili kuzuia matumizi mabaya (vikomo vya kasi) na kuweka huduma salama. Inahifadhiwa tu katika vihesabu vya muda mfupi na katika kumbukumbu za seva. Hatuitumii kujua ulipo. Msingi: maslahi halali (usalama).

pages.privacy.40.en: Server error reports: the error, the route, and the request method and path (no query strings or request contents)
pages.privacy.40.text: Ripoti za hitilafu za seva: hitilafu, njia (route), na mbinu na njia ya ombi (bila vigezo vya hoja wala maudhui ya ombi)

pages.privacy.41.en: To fix faults in our server. Basis: legitimate interests.
pages.privacy.41.text: Ili kurekebisha hitilafu katika seva yetu. Msingi: maslahi halali.

pages.privacy.42.en: Crash reports from the game (optional, below)
pages.privacy.42.text: Ripoti za hitilafu kutoka kwenye mchezo (hiari, hapa chini)

pages.privacy.44.en: Play statistics (optional, adults only, below): what you do in the game under a random statistics id
pages.privacy.44.text: Takwimu za mchezo (hiari, watu wazima pekee, hapa chini): unachofanya kwenye mchezo chini ya kitambulisho cha takwimu cha nasibu

pages.privacy.45.en: To see where players get stuck and whether changes help. Basis: consent.
pages.privacy.45.text: Ili kuona wachezaji wanapokwama na kama mabadiliko yanasaidia. Msingi: ridhaa.

pages.privacy.46.en: Support email and web deletion requests
pages.privacy.46.text: Barua pepe za usaidizi na maombi ya kufuta kupitia wavuti

pages.privacy.47.en: To answer you and carry out your request, and to keep a record that we did. Basis: legitimate interests; for deletion requests, legal obligation.
pages.privacy.47.text: Ili kukujibu na kutekeleza ombi lako, na kuhifadhi kumbukumbu kwamba tulifanya hivyo. Msingi: maslahi halali; kwa maombi ya kufuta, wajibu wa kisheria.

pages.privacy.48.en: If you ask the game to find your Game Center friends, we use their ids once to see which of them play Kagemura; we do not keep that list. We do not make decisions about you by automated means that have legal or similarly significant effects. One automatic safety step exists: a chat message reported by three different players is hidden until our staff look at it.
pages.privacy.48.text: Ukiuomba mchezo kutafuta marafiki zako wa Game Center, tunatumia vitambulisho vyao mara moja kuona ni wapi kati yao wanaocheza Kagemura; hatuhifadhi orodha hiyo. Hatufanyi maamuzi kukuhusu kwa njia za kiotomatiki yenye athari za kisheria au athari kubwa zinazofanana. Kuna hatua moja ya usalama ya kiotomatiki: ujumbe wa gumzo ulioripotiwa na wachezaji watatu tofauti hufichwa hadi wafanyakazi wetu wautazame.

pages.privacy.49.en: Play statistics (off unless you say yes; adults only)
pages.privacy.49.text: Takwimu za mchezo (zimezimwa isipokuwa ukisema ndiyo; watu wazima pekee)

pages.privacy.50.en: When you play online and have told us you are an adult, the game asks once whether you want to share play statistics; Settings has the same switch. It is off until you say yes, and the game never asks, or sends statistics, for players under 18 or whose age it does not know. When it is on, the game sends what you do in the game (sessions starting, tutorial steps, raids with their stars and destruction, upgrades and research started, offers shown, Jade spent on speed-ups and purchases with their product and price) under a random statistics id made for this purpose. The statistics id is not your Player ID and is never sent together with it; the game does not add your name, village, chat or sign-in token, and our server does not store the IP address with them. Saying yes also sends what this device recorded before (so we can see the first minutes of play). Turning the switch off deletes what that statistics id sent; saying yes again starts a new one. We keep shared statistics for 400 days and use them only in totals (for example, how many new players came back the next day). Players who share may receive slightly different timings for in-game offers, to compare which works better; prices, rewards and game rules are the same for everyone.
pages.privacy.50.text: Unapocheza mtandaoni na umetuambia kwamba wewe ni mtu mzima, mchezo unauliza mara moja kama unataka kushiriki takwimu za mchezo; Mipangilio ina swichi hiyo hiyo. Imezimwa hadi useme ndiyo, na mchezo kamwe hauulizi, wala hautumi takwimu, kwa wachezaji walio chini ya miaka 18 au ambao umri wao haujulikani. Ikiwa imewashwa, mchezo hutuma unachofanya kwenye mchezo (vipindi vinavyoanza, hatua za mafunzo ya mwanzo, mavamizi pamoja na nyota na uharibifu wake, maboresho na tafiti zilizoanzishwa, ofa zilizoonyeshwa, Jade iliyotumika kuharakisha na manunuzi pamoja na bidhaa na bei yake) chini ya kitambulisho cha takwimu cha nasibu kilichotengenezwa kwa kusudi hili. Kitambulisho cha takwimu si Kitambulisho chako cha Mchezaji na kamwe hakitumwi pamoja nacho; mchezo hauongezi jina lako, kijiji, gumzo wala tokeni ya kuingia, na seva yetu haihifadhi anwani ya IP pamoja nazo. Kusema ndiyo pia hutuma kile kifaa hiki kilirekodi awali (ili tuone dakika za kwanza za mchezo). Kuzima swichi hufuta kile kitambulisho hicho cha takwimu kilituma; kusema ndiyo tena huanzisha kipya. Tunahifadhi takwimu zilizoshirikiwa kwa siku 400 na tunazitumia kwa jumla tu (kwa mfano, ni wachezaji wangapi wapya walirudi siku iliyofuata). Wachezaji wanaoshiriki wanaweza kupokea nyakati tofauti kidogo za ofa ndani ya mchezo, ili kulinganisha ipi inafanya kazi vizuri zaidi; bei, zawadi na sheria za mchezo ni sawa kwa kila mtu.

pages.privacy.51.en: Crash reports (off unless you turn them on)

pages.privacy.52.en: Versions of the game that include crash reporting show a "Send crash reports" switch in Settings. It is off until you turn it on. When it is on and the game hits an error, the game sends the error message, where in the game's code it happened, the game version and the platform to our error-tracking service (Sentry). The game does not attach your name, Player ID, village, chat or save, and removes web-address parameters and anything shaped like an email address from the message. An error message can still occasionally include text the game was working on when it failed. The service sees the IP address the report comes from; we set the service not to store IP addresses. Turning the switch off stops new reports at once.
pages.privacy.52.text: Matoleo ya mchezo yenye kuripoti hitilafu huonyesha swichi ya "Tuma ripoti za hitilafu" kwenye Mipangilio. Imezimwa hadi uiwashe. Ikiwa imewashwa na mchezo ukakumbana na hitilafu, mchezo hutuma ujumbe wa hitilafu, mahali katika msimbo wa mchezo ilipotokea, toleo la mchezo na jukwaa kwa huduma yetu ya kufuatilia hitilafu (Sentry). Mchezo hauambatishi jina lako, Kitambulisho cha Mchezaji, kijiji, gumzo wala hifadhi, na huondoa vigezo vya anwani za wavuti na chochote chenye umbo la anwani ya barua pepe kutoka kwenye ujumbe. Ujumbe wa hitilafu bado unaweza mara chache kuwa na maandishi ambayo mchezo ulikuwa ukishughulikia ulipofeli. Huduma huona anwani ya IP ripoti inakotoka; tumeiweka huduma isihifadhi anwani za IP. Kuzima swichi husimamisha ripoti mpya mara moja.

pages.privacy.54.en: When you report a message or a player, our staff review it and can remove the message, mute chat or suspend the account (see the {t0}community rules{t1}). We tell the player who reported what happened, and we tell a player when we remove their message, mute them or suspend them, with the reason and how to appeal. We do not tell a reported player who reported them. Every staff action is logged so that decisions can be checked.
pages.privacy.54.text: Unaporipoti ujumbe au mchezaji, wafanyakazi wetu huikagua na wanaweza kuondoa ujumbe, kunyamazisha gumzo au kusimamisha akaunti (tazama {t0}sheria za jumuiya{t1}). Tunamwambia mchezaji aliyeripoti kilichotokea, na tunamwambia mchezaji tunapoondoa ujumbe wake, kumnyamazisha au kumsimamisha, pamoja na sababu na jinsi ya kukata rufaa. Hatumwambii mchezaji aliyeripotiwa ni nani aliyemripoti. Kila hatua ya wafanyakazi hurekodiwa ili maamuzi yaweze kukaguliwa.

pages.privacy.56.en: {t0}Support email.{t1} If you write to us, we receive your email address and what you send, and use them only to answer you and keep a record of that answer.
pages.privacy.56.text: {t0}Barua pepe ya usaidizi.{t1} Ukituandikia, tunapokea anwani yako ya barua pepe na unachotuma, na tunavitumia tu kukujibu na kuhifadhi kumbukumbu ya jibu hilo.

pages.privacy.57.en: {t0}Web deletion requests.{t1} The account deletion page asks for your Player ID, the deletion code the game gives you, and an optional note. It does not ask for an email address. We keep the request and what we did about it as a record that it was handled.
pages.privacy.57.text: {t0}Maombi ya kufuta kupitia wavuti.{t1} Ukurasa wa kufuta akaunti unaomba Kitambulisho chako cha Mchezaji, msimbo wa kufuta ambao mchezo unakupa, na maelezo ya hiari. Hauombi anwani ya barua pepe. Tunahifadhi ombi na tulichofanya kulihusu kama kumbukumbu kwamba lilishughulikiwa.

pages.privacy.59.en: We do not ask for your email address in the game, and we do not collect your contacts, precise location, photos or advertising id. There are no ads and no third-party tracking, and we do not sell your data or share it for advertising or cross-context behavioural advertising.
pages.privacy.59.text: Hatuombi anwani yako ya barua pepe katika mchezo, na hatukusanyi anwani za watu unaowasiliana nao, mahali ulipo hasa, picha wala kitambulisho cha matangazo. Hakuna matangazo wala ufuatiliaji wa wahusika wengine, na hatuuzi data yako wala kuishiriki kwa matangazo au matangazo yanayotegemea tabia katika miktadha mbalimbali.

pages.privacy.61.en: We use service providers who process data only on our instructions: our hosting provider (server and database: {t0}{t1}), our error-tracking service Sentry (crash reports only if you turn them on, and our server's own errors; data region: {t2}{t3}), and Apple and Google (sign-in, purchases and notifications, under their own privacy policies). Our staff see what they need to answer support and moderate.
pages.privacy.61.text: Tunatumia watoa huduma wanaochakata data kwa maagizo yetu tu: mtoa huduma wetu wa kupangisha (seva na hifadhidata: {t0}{t1}), huduma yetu ya kufuatilia hitilafu Sentry (ripoti za hitilafu ukiziwasha tu, na hitilafu za seva yetu wenyewe; eneo la data: {t2}{t3}), na Apple na Google (kuingia, manunuzi na arifa, chini ya sera zao za faragha). Wafanyakazi wetu huona kile wanachohitaji kujibu maombi ya usaidizi na kusimamia.

pages.privacy.62.en: Some of these providers may process data outside your country, including outside the EU, UK or Brazil. Where data leaves the EU or UK for a country without an adequacy decision, we rely on the European Commission's Standard Contractual Clauses (and the UK addendum or International Data Transfer Agreement) or another transfer mechanism the law allows. You can ask us for a copy of the safeguards.
pages.privacy.62.text: Baadhi ya watoa huduma hawa wanaweza kuchakata data nje ya nchi yako, ikiwemo nje ya Umoja wa Ulaya, Uingereza au Brazili. Data inapotoka Umoja wa Ulaya au Uingereza kwenda nchi isiyo na uamuzi wa utoshelevu, tunategemea Vifungu vya Kawaida vya Mkataba vya Tume ya Ulaya (na nyongeza ya Uingereza au Makubaliano ya Uhamishaji wa Data Kimataifa) au utaratibu mwingine wa uhamishaji unaoruhusiwa na sheria. Unaweza kutuomba nakala ya kinga hizo.

pages.privacy.64.en: Your online account and what belongs to it: as long as the account exists. Accounts not used online for {t0}{t1} are deleted after a notice in the game.
pages.privacy.64.text: Akaunti yako ya mtandaoni na kilicho chake: muda wote akaunti ipo. Akaunti zisizotumika mtandaoni kwa {t0}{t1} hufutwa baada ya taarifa ndani ya mchezo.

pages.privacy.71.text: Maombi ya kufuta kupitia wavuti yaliyoshughulikiwa: {t0}{t1}.

pages.privacy.72.text: Kumbukumbu za manunuzi huhifadhiwa baada ya akaunti kufutwa, bila Kitambulisho chako cha Mchezaji, kwa muda ambao sheria za kodi na marejesho ya pesa zinataka.

pages.privacy.74.en: {t0}In the game:{t1} Settings → Online play → Account → Delete online account.
pages.privacy.74.text: {t0}Ndani ya mchezo:{t1} Mipangilio → Kucheza mtandaoni → Akaunti → Futa akaunti ya mtandaoni.

pages.privacy.75.en: {t0}On the web, if you can no longer open the game:{t1} {t2}{t3}. Enter your Player ID and a deletion code: ask for one in Settings → Online play → Account while you still have the game (it works once and for 30 days; asking again replaces it, and we keep only a one-way hash of it). With the code we carry the request out; without it, we first have to make sure the request comes from the account's owner, because Player IDs and names are visible to other players. We carry out requests within 30 days.
pages.privacy.75.text: {t0}Kwenye wavuti, ikiwa huwezi tena kufungua mchezo:{t1} {t2}{t3}. Weka Kitambulisho chako cha Mchezaji na msimbo wa kufuta: uombe katika Mipangilio → Kucheza mtandaoni → Akaunti ukiwa bado una mchezo (unafanya kazi mara moja na kwa siku 30; kuomba tena huubadilisha, na tunahifadhi hashi yake ya njia moja tu). Ukiwa na msimbo tunatekeleza ombi; bila msimbo, kwanza lazima tuhakikishe ombi linatoka kwa mmiliki wa akaunti, kwa sababu Vitambulisho vya Mchezaji na majina huonekana kwa wachezaji wengine. Tunatekeleza maombi ndani ya siku 30.

pages.privacy.76.en: Deleting removes your online account, name, base, chat messages, friends, Gang membership, reports you made, linked sign-ins and the village kept on our server. If you linked Sign in with Apple, we also ask Apple to revoke the game's access. Raids you made stay in other players' replays as "Deleted player"; purchase records stay without your Player ID (above).
pages.privacy.76.text: Kufuta huondoa akaunti yako ya mtandaoni, jina, kambi, jumbe za gumzo, marafiki, uanachama wa Genge, ripoti ulizotoa, njia za kuingia zilizounganishwa na kijiji kinachohifadhiwa kwenye seva yetu. Ikiwa uliunganisha Sign in with Apple, pia tunaiomba Apple ibatilishe ufikiaji wa mchezo. Mavamizi uliyofanya hubaki katika marudio ya wachezaji wengine kama "Mchezaji aliyefutwa"; kumbukumbu za manunuzi hubaki bila Kitambulisho chako cha Mchezaji (hapo juu).

pages.privacy.77.en: {t0}Your village on the device{t1} is removed by uninstalling the app or clearing the site's data in your browser; Settings → "Start a new village" replaces it.
pages.privacy.77.text: {t0}Kijiji chako kwenye kifaa{t1} huondolewa kwa kuondoa programu au kufuta data ya tovuti kwenye kivinjari chako; Mipangilio → "Anzisha kijiji kipya" hukibadilisha.

pages.privacy.79.en: Wherever you live, you can ask us to:

pages.privacy.80.en: {t0}access{t1} your data and get a copy, and receive the data you gave us in a commonly used, machine-readable form ({t2}portability{t3});
pages.privacy.80.text: {t0}kufikia{t1} data yako na kupata nakala, na kupokea data uliyotupa katika muundo unaotumika sana unaosomeka na mashine ({t2}uhamishikaji{t3});

pages.privacy.82.en: {t0}restrict{t1} how we use it while a question is being settled, and {t2}object{t3} to uses based on legitimate interests;
pages.privacy.82.text: {t0}kuzuia{t1} jinsi tunavyoitumia wakati swali linashughulikiwa, na {t2}kupinga{t3} matumizi yanayotegemea maslahi halali;

pages.privacy.83.en: {t0}withdraw consent{t1} at any time (crash reports, play statistics, notifications: Settings), without affecting what happened before. Turning play statistics off also deletes what was shared.
pages.privacy.83.text: {t0}kuondoa ridhaa{t1} wakati wowote (ripoti za hitilafu, takwimu za mchezo, arifa: Mipangilio), bila kuathiri kilichotokea kabla. Kuzima takwimu za mchezo pia hufuta kilichoshirikiwa.

pages.privacy.84.en: Write to {t0}{t1} with your Player ID. We answer within one month (in Brazil, within the time the LGPD sets; in California, within 45 days) and may need to confirm the account is yours first. You can also complain to a data protection authority: in the EU the authority where you live or work, in the UK the Information Commissioner's Office (ico.org.uk), in Brazil the ANPD (gov.br/anpd). Residents of California have the rights of the CCPA/CPRA, including to know, delete, correct and not be discriminated against for using them; we do not sell or share personal information as those laws define it. Under the LGPD you can also ask for confirmation that we process your data, anonymisation, information about whom we share it with, and the consequences of refusing consent.
pages.privacy.84.text: Mwandikie {t0}{t1} ukiwa na Kitambulisho chako cha Mchezaji. Tunajibu ndani ya mwezi mmoja (Brazili, ndani ya muda ambao LGPD inaweka; California, ndani ya siku 45) na huenda tukahitaji kwanza kuthibitisha kwamba akaunti ni yako. Unaweza pia kulalamika kwa mamlaka ya ulinzi wa data: katika Umoja wa Ulaya mamlaka ya mahali unapoishi au kufanya kazi, Uingereza Ofisi ya Kamishna wa Habari (ico.org.uk), Brazili ANPD (gov.br/anpd). Wakazi wa California wana haki za CCPA/CPRA, zikiwemo kujua, kufuta, kurekebisha na kutobaguliwa kwa kuzitumia; hatuuzi wala kushiriki taarifa binafsi kama sheria hizo zinavyozifafanua. Chini ya LGPD unaweza pia kuomba uthibitisho kwamba tunachakata data yako, kuifanya isitambulike, taarifa kuhusu tunaowashirikisha, na matokeo ya kukataa ridhaa.

pages.privacy.86.en: Purchases are made through the App Store or Google Play. They handle your payment details; we never see them. The {t0}terms of service{t1} describe Jade and other purchases.
pages.privacy.86.text: Manunuzi hufanywa kupitia App Store au Google Play. Wao hushughulikia maelezo yako ya malipo; sisi kamwe hatuyaoni. {t0}Masharti ya huduma{t1} yanaeleza Jade na manunuzi mengine.

pages.privacy.88.en: The game talks to our server only over encrypted connections (HTTPS), sign-in tokens are stored as one-way hashes, and staff access is limited and logged. No system is perfectly secure; if a breach affects you, we will tell you and the authorities as the law requires.
pages.privacy.88.text: Mchezo huwasiliana na seva yetu kupitia miunganisho iliyosimbwa (HTTPS) pekee, tokeni za kuingia huhifadhiwa kama hashi za njia moja, na ufikiaji wa wafanyakazi una mipaka na hurekodiwa. Hakuna mfumo ulio salama kikamilifu; uvunjaji wa usalama ukikuathiri, tutakuambia wewe na mamlaka kama sheria inavyotaka.

pages.privacy.90.en: We update this page and its date when what we collect changes, and tell players in the game about important changes.
pages.privacy.90.text: Tunasasisha ukurasa huu na tarehe yake tunachokusanya kinapobadilika, na tunawaambia wachezaji ndani ya mchezo kuhusu mabadiliko muhimu.

pages.support.6.text: Ukicheza mtandaoni, weka Kitambulisho chako cha Mchezaji (Mipangilio → Kucheza mtandaoni → Akaunti) na, kwa ununuzi, tarehe na nambari ya agizo ya duka. Kamwe usitume msimbo wako wa hifadhi wala nenosiri la mtu yeyote.

A village kept on our server comes back when you sign in on the new device with a sign-in you linked (Settings → Online play → Account → Sign-ins).
pages.support.9.text: Kuhamisha kijiji kwenda kifaa kingine, tumia Mipangilio → {t0}Nakili msimbo wa hifadhi{t1} kwenye kifaa cha zamani na {t2}Pakia kutoka msimbo{t3} kwenye kipya. pages.support.10.en: If the game says the village is {t0}open somewhere else{t1}, close the other tab or app: only the one opened last saves.

pages.support.12.en: If a purchase did not arrive, open the Store and tap {t0}Restore purchases{t1} while online. A purchase waiting for a parent's approval or the store arrives when it is approved.
pages.support.12.text: Ikiwa ununuzi haukufika, fungua Duka na ugonge {t0}Rejesha manunuzi{t1} ukiwa mtandaoni. Ununuzi unaosubiri idhini ya mzazi au ya duka hufika ukishaidhinishwa.

pages.support.13.en: Refunds are handled by Apple or Google: ask them through your App Store or Google Play purchase history. When a store refunds a purchase, what it gave can be taken back from a village kept on our server.

pages.support.18.text: {t0}Hakuna muunganisho{t1}: unaweza kuendelea kujenga; ikiwa kijiji chako kinahifadhiwa kwenye seva yetu, mchezo huhifadhi vitendo vyako na kuvituma ukirudi mtandaoni. Mavamizi dhidi ya wachezaji halisi, Miungano, marafiki na manunuzi yanahitaji muunganisho.

pages.support.20.en: {t0}Suspended or muted{t1}: the account broke the {t2}community rules{t3}. The game tells you why and for how long. To appeal, write to us with your Player ID within six months: someone who did not take the first decision looks at it again.
pages.support.20.text: {t0}Imesimamishwa au imenyamazishwa{t1}: akaunti ilivunja {t2}sheria za jumuiya{t3}. Mchezo unakuambia kwa nini na kwa muda gani. Kukata rufaa, tuandikie ukiwa na Kitambulisho chako cha Mchezaji ndani ya miezi sita: mtu ambaye hakufanya uamuzi wa kwanza ataiangalia upya.

pages.support.21.en: {t0}Age group{t1}: the game asks a year of birth once before online play and keeps only the age group. Players under 13 chat only with fixed phrases, get a generated name and cannot be found by name; players aged 13 to 17 start hidden from strangers with their online status off. The game can only make the age group stricter; parents, write to us if your child gave a wrong age.
pages.support.21.text: {t0}Kundi la umri{t1}: mchezo unauliza mwaka wa kuzaliwa mara moja kabla ya kucheza mtandaoni na unahifadhi kundi la umri tu. Wachezaji walio chini ya miaka 13 huzungumza kwa misemo iliyowekwa tu, hupewa jina lililotengenezwa na hawawezi kupatikana kwa jina; wachezaji wenye umri wa miaka 13 hadi 17 huanza wakiwa wamefichwa kwa wasiowajua na hali yao ya mtandaoni ikiwa imezimwa. Mchezo unaweza tu kufanya kundi la umri kuwa kali zaidi; wazazi, tuandikieni ikiwa mtoto wenu alitoa umri usio sahihi.

pages.support.23.en: Tap {t0}⋯{t1} next to their message in Alliance or Gang chat, in the Alliance member list or on a friend card to {t2}Report{t3} or {t4}Block{t5} them. Blocking hides their chat and requests from you at once. We tell you what we decided about your report, and we never tell the other player who reported them. See the {t6}community rules{t7}. If someone is in danger, contact your local emergency services first.
pages.support.23.text: Gusa {t0}⋯{t1} kando ya ujumbe wake kwenye gumzo la Muungano au Genge, kwenye orodha ya wanachama wa Muungano au kwenye kadi ya rafiki ili {t2}Kumripoti{t3} au {t4}Kumzuia{t5}. Ikiwa mtu yuko hatarini, kwanza wasiliana na huduma za dharura za eneo lako.

Without the game: {t2}{t3}, with your Player ID or name and a {t4}deletion code{t5}: get one in Settings → Online play → Account while you still have the game (it works once, for 30 days). pages.community.2.text: Kagemura: Koo za Ninja · kwa majina ya wachezaji, gumzo la Muungano na Genge, marafiki, maombi ya wapiganaji na vita vya mtandaoni

pages.community.4.en: Kagemura is a game for a general audience, played by people of many ages, countries and languages. By using online play you agree to these rules. Breaking them can get messages removed, chat muted or an account suspended.
pages.community.4.text: Kagemura ni mchezo kwa hadhira ya jumla, unaochezwa na watu wa umri, nchi na lugha mbalimbali. Kwa kutumia kucheza mtandaoni unakubali sheria hizi. Kuzivunja kunaweza kusababisha jumbe kuondolewa, gumzo kunyamazishwa au akaunti kusimamishwa.

pages.community.5.en: These rules are part of the {t0}{t1}.

pages.community.7.en: No harassment, bullying, threats or hate, in any language, spelling or code word.
pages.community.7.text: Hakuna unyanyasaji, uonevu, vitisho au chuki, kwa lugha, tahajia au neno la siri lolote.

pages.community.8.en: No sexual content, and nothing that sexualises or endangers children.
pages.community.8.text: Hakuna maudhui ya ngono, wala chochote kinachowaonyesha watoto kingono au kuwahatarisha.

pages.community.9.en: No names that insult, impersonate another player, staff or a real person, or pretend to be official.
pages.community.9.text: Hakuna majina yanayotukana, yanayojifanya kuwa mchezaji mwingine, mfanyakazi au mtu halisi, au yanayojifanya kuwa rasmi.

pages.community.10.en: No spam, advertising, scams, or links to cheats.
pages.community.10.text: Hakuna barua taka, matangazo, utapeli, wala viungo vya udanganyifu.

pages.community.11.en: Do not share personal details: yours or anyone else's (real name, address, phone, school, social accounts). Never ask other players for them.
pages.community.11.text: Usishiriki taarifa binafsi: zako au za mtu mwingine yeyote (jina halisi, anwani, simu, shule, akaunti za mitandao ya kijamii). Kamwe usiwaombe wachezaji wengine taarifa hizo.

pages.community.13.en: Before online play, the game asks for your year of birth (or uses the age range your phone's app store shares) and keeps only an age group, never the date.

pages.community.14.en: Players under 13 chat with ready-made messages only, keep the name the game gave them, and can be found only by friend code.

pages.community.15.en: Players aged 13 to 17 start hidden from strangers (only friends of friends can find them by name) and with their online status hidden; they can change this in Friends → Privacy. Offers never pop up for players under 18, and they have a monthly spending limit.

pages.community.16.en: An age group can only be made stricter in the game. If it is wrong, contact support.

pages.community.18.en: No cheating: no modified games, bots, scripts or tools that play for you or change battles. Our server checks battles and refuses ones it cannot reproduce.

pages.community.19.en: Do not exploit bugs. Tell us about them instead ({t0}support{t1}).

pages.community.20.en: Do not buy, sell or share accounts, or trade game items for real money.

pages.community.21.en: Do not use other people's payment methods, or refund purchases you used in order to keep them.

pages.community.23.en: {t0}Block{t1}: tap {t2}⋯{t3} next to a message, a member or a friend card. You stop seeing their chat and requests at once, and they can no longer find you or send you friend requests.

pages.community.24.en: {t0}Report{t1}: from the same {t2}⋯{t3} menu, choose a reason and, if you like, add a note. A message reported by three different players is hidden for everyone until staff decide.

pages.community.25.en: If someone is in danger, contact your local emergency services first.

pages.community.27.en: Staff review reports and can remove messages, mute a player's chat and suspend accounts. Every staff action is logged. When we act, the player affected gets a message in the game (Settings → Online play → Account) saying what we decided, the reason and how to appeal, and everyone who reported it hears the outcome.
